items.title: 'Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
items.summary: Production company Asmik Ace opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Juntarou Aoki and Shin Moriyama's Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara (Getting Shots on Frying Pan) manga on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a teaser promotional video. Produced by J.C.Staff, the anime is scheduled to premiere on Nippon TV, Yomiuri TV, BS Nippon TV, and AT-X in January 2027. Voice actors Shuu Uchida (Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika wo Kouryakuchuu) and Masaaki Mizunaka (Nyaight of the Living Cat) are voicing the beautiful girl and male versions of Juntarou Aoki, respectively. Staff Director: Masahiro Hiraoka (Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière) Series Composition, Script: Susumu Yamakawa (Maiko-san Chi no Makanai-san) Character Design, Chief Animation Director: Natsuki Ooyama (Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!)) Music: Yoshihide Ootomo (Inu-Ou) Sound Director: Yoshikazu Iwanami (Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo) Aoki began serializing the slice of life manga, with illustrations by Moriyama, on Comic Newtype website in May 2021. Kadokawa published the fifth volume in October 2024. A spin-off series titled Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara Transit featuring Hirota Takahara, began serializing on March 20. Teaser PV Official site: https://nabetama.asmik-ace.co.jp/ Source: Comic Natalie

items.text:
Asmik Ace a lancé le site officiel de l’adaptation télévisée du manga *Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara*. Le projet, produit par J.C.Staff, révèle le casting principal – Shuu Uchida et Masaaki Mizunaka – ainsi que l’équipe créative, dont le réalisateur Masahiro Hiraoka et le compositeur Yoshihide Ootomo. La série doit être diffusée sur Nippon TV, Yomiuri TV, BS Nippon TV et AT‑X en janvier 2027.
